note: For the alate the original reads IMAGO. Not known so far. The description comes from the redefinition of the genus Grallatotermes in JBNHS 63(1), in which this species is the type species of the genus. The original gives no measurements.

sections.label: Soldier
sections.text: Head capsule and antennae slightly dark reddish brown, thoracic nota brown, abdominal tergites pale brown with darker margins. Head pyriform in dorsal view, with short hairs, its length (to the base of the rostrum) slightly greater than the greatest width, with a shallow constriction behind the antennal bases. Rostrum distinctly conical, broad at the base, slightly upturned at the tip in lateral view. Antennae 13-segmented, segment 3 longer than segment 2. Mandibles reduced, each with a short blade rudiment (the points and the lateral spinous process), the blade rudiment of the left mandible with a distinct tooth at the tip, the right mandible toothless. Pronotum saddle-shaped. Legs very long relative to body length, the hind femur extending beyond the end of the abdomen, tibial spur formula 2:2:2. Abdominal tergites hairless, sternites with many short and long hairs.

sections.label: Worker
sections.text: Head brown, antennae, labrum and pronotum paler than the head, postclypeus the same colour as the frons. Head nearly oval, width almost equal to length, cranial suture distinct, fontanelle plate nearly oval and almost central. Antennae 14-segmented. Postclypeus weakly swollen, its length about 1/3 of the greatest width. Anteclypeus nearly trapezoidal. Left mandible with 1 apical and 2 marginal teeth, the apical tooth distinctly shorter than the 1st marginal tooth (0.02 mm apart), left mandible index 0.25, the angle between the apical and 1st marginal teeth about 45°; 1st marginal tooth large, its posterior margin wavy rather than straight, a rounded notch before the 2nd marginal tooth (the 3rd marginal tooth of other authors), that tooth small and separated from the molar region by a deep concavity. Right mandible also with 1 apical and 2 marginal teeth; the apical tooth shorter than the 1st marginal tooth, right mandible index 0.83; 1st marginal tooth large, anterior margin slightly convex, posterior margin weakly concave; 2nd marginal tooth smaller than the 1st, its posterior margin nearly 5 times the anterior margin; molar region large, almost as long as the rest of the mandible (index 0.95), its surface convex and serrate.
